ibop.2024.4.1.printed_source_pages: Practical Exam: Bioinformatics, English (Official), pages Q1-1–Q1-3 (appendix excerpts from pages Q0-1, Q0-4, Q0-5)

ibop.2024.4.1.source_variant_note: The PDF prints the marking scheme and correct answers of the whole practical after the tasks ("Marking and correct answers", from page 27); they were not used. The general instructions (G0-1–G0-5) are not repeated. The paper's table of contents gives the appendix as Q1-1… and the tasks as Q2-1, Q3-1, Q4-1, while the pages themselves are headed Q0-1–Q0-11 (appendix), Q1-, Q2- and Q3- (tasks); the page headers are used here. The datasets (csv/fasta inputs) were provided only inside the exam application and are not printed in the paper. Included from the appendix as printed: the "CLUSTAL" format description with its Figure 1 (Appendix 1, page Q0-1) and the rows of tools 7 and 10 of the tool table (Appendix 2, pages Q0-4–Q0-5, rendered as a list). Question 1.6.1 is printed as "[CANCELED]" (1.0 pt); the task total printed in the general instructions is 18 points, the printed question points add up to 19 with the cancelled question. Printed as in the paper: "How many degrees of freedom does this chi-square test has?"; "at the 5% significance value"; the task calls the tool "#10. Chi-square" while the tool table names it "10. Chi-square test".
